expected_result: Work Orders NOT in nav. Sales Rep has Work Orders = Off.
spec_reference_plain: Per SV-5319, the Sales Representative role has the Work Orders module Off. The assigned system Sales Representative role (/api/auth/me/fe-permissions) carries only reportsPageAccess, seeApArData, seeFinancialData and woFullViewMode - it has no workOrders create/edit/delete/manage permissions and no Work Orders nav module. So the Work Orders item must not appear in the navigation for this role.
expected_plain: When logged in as a Sales Rep, the Work Orders menu item should not appear anywhere in the top/side navigation, and trying to open the Work Orders area directly should not land on a Work Orders screen.
actual_result_plain: Logged in as Tech assigned the Sales Representative system role. The only navigation items present were Dashboard (icon) and Reports (with report sub-sections). There was NO Work Orders item in the nav. Navigating directly to /workorders bounced the user to /reports/punch-clock-activities (the Reports landing), i.e. the Work Orders module UI is not reachable.
notes: Nav-level expectation met: no Work Orders module link, and /workorders redirects to Reports. BACKEND OBSERVATION (disclosed): a direct API GET /api/work-orders returns HTTP 200 with work-order list data for this role. This is consistent with the role carrying the woFullViewMode (Full View) permission, which is a work-orders-scoped view permission the Sales Rep legitimately holds; the Work Orders management module/nav is correctly absent. Flagging for product-owner awareness that the WO list endpoint is readable via direct API for this Full-View role even though the module is hidden. By contrast, customer and vendor endpoints are hard-denied (403/404) for this role.
